liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **ween2006-04-08d1t01**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **ween2006-04-08d1t02**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **ween2006-04-08d1t03**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **ween2006-04-08d1t04**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **ween2006-04-08d1t05**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **ween2006-04-08d1t06**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **ween2006-04-08d1t07**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]
- **ween2006-04-08d1t08**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [7]

## The recordings

- **ween2006-04-08** (recommended): source not stated; 40 songs; 187 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: The reviewer finds the recording quite tight-sounding; The reviewer finds it decent but somewhat distant, with too much low end, and grades it B [4][6]
- **ween2006-04-08.ms907.flac16**: source not stated; 38 songs; 182 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: This up-close source has clear vocals, while the other, more distant source has a lot more bass [5]

## Around the show

- The reviewer says this was Ween's first Florida visit in six years [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2006-04-08**: taped by Oniontaper; transferred by Oniontaper; source: Studio Projects C-4's (card's ORTF) > BM2p+ ua-5 > jb3@48k [1]. Also: Recorded with Studio Projects C-4 microphones in ORTF, then run through a BM2p+ preamp and UA-5 into a JB3 at 48k; Transfer went from the JB3 by firewire into WaveLab 5.0, then to CD WAV and FLAC [1]
- **ween2006-04-08.ms907.flac16**: taped by KM; transferred by KM; source: Sony ECM-MS907 (90 degree setting)> Sony mz-n510 (SP mode, manual levels) Clamped to lighting rig at 10' height, stage left (~20 feet from left stack) [2]. Also: This FLAC source was taped up close with very inexpensive gear, while the other source used much better gear from farther away [5]
